recipes.title: Garlic Chicken & Broccoli Stir-fry
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add chicken, cook until no longer pink.
Add broccoli and stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Season to taste and serve hot.

recipes.title: Roasted Chicken & Broccoli Tray Bake
instructions: Toss chicken and broccoli with oil, salt, pepper, and minced garlic.
Bake for 18–22 minutes until cooked through.
